texts: The essential underlying anatomic feature of tetralogy of Fallot is anterior deviation of the infundibular septum: A.

The outlet septum is displaced forward and upward: it narrows the right ventricular outflow, leaves a malalignment VSD beneath the aorta, lets the aorta override the septum, and the obstructed right ventricle hypertrophies.
Aortic override is a consequence of the deviation, not its cause, and its degree varies widely from patient to patient.
In the picture, one shove of the funnel's wall comes first, and all four blocks of the Tetris piece fall from it.
Memory hook: shove the funnel's wall, and the four blocks fall.
